regions.summary: Plain between the Ru and Ying rivers: rural Shangcai (east part) and Shangshui, with a bit of Zhaoling.

candidates.name: Shangshui
candidates.meaning: "Shang water": from the Shang (Yin) river, renamed in 960 to avoid a taboo on the emperor's father's name Hongyin.
candidates.fit: 41% of the people, holding over half of the county; its seat lies outside the region.
candidates.source_note: 隋朝时因境内有一条大河大殷水……设殷水县；宋建隆元年改殷水为商水

candidates.name: Shangcai
candidates.meaning: "Upper Cai": first capital of the Zhou-era state of Cai.
candidates.fit: 51% of the people, but the county seat sits in region 2, which suits the name better.
candidates.source_note: 周成王把蔡地封给蔡叔度之子蔡仲胡为国，定都于今上蔡县

regions.notes: Shangcai is the stronger fit for region 2 (it holds the county seat); Shangshui is the cleaner choice here. Shangshui is only 53% inside this region, so check the Zhoukou regions do not also take it.

regions.summary: Xiping and the Shangcai county seat, on the plain north of Zhumadian.

candidates.name: Shangcai
candidates.meaning: "Upper Cai": first capital of the Zhou-era state of Cai; birthplace of Li Si.
candidates.fit: Holds the county seat (Caidu) and 46% of the people; the region is about half Shangcai.
candidates.source_note: 周成王把蔡地封给蔡叔度之子蔡仲胡为国，定都于今上蔡县

candidates.name: Xiping
candidates.meaning: "West level": Han county, earlier the state of Bai.
candidates.fit: 52% of the people, but only 72% of the county; the county seat lies in this region.
candidates.source_note: 西平县古为柏皇氏遗族封地，春秋称柏国，汉高帝四年始置县

regions.summary: Foothills east of Funiu and the Sha river headwaters: Wugang, Fangcheng, Suiping, Xiping, Biyang and Yicheng parts.

candidates.name: Chayashan
candidates.meaning: Rugged, jagged peaks: a granite range on the eastern edge of the Funiu foothills, nicknamed the Monkey King's mountain; the Chayashan commune of 1958 was China's first people's commune.
candidates.fit: Lies in Suiping county's west, within this region; marks the foothill edge where Wugang, Suiping, Xiping and Biyang meet.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 1203 hits with 河南, mostly about this mountain and its commune.
candidates.source_note: 嵖岈山位于河南省驻马店市遂平县境内，於伏牛山东缘余脉

candidates.name: Lihe
candidates.meaning: The Li River, a Sha River tributary rising in Fangcheng county and running east.
candidates.fit: Rises inside the region's Fangcheng part but runs on north of it, so it fits only partly.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; thin outside Henan.
candidates.source_note: 发源于方城县四里店乡北部

candidates.name: Wugang
candidates.meaning: "Wu steel": a steel city founded in the 1970s around the Wu Steel plant.
candidates.fit: 25% of the people and 98% of the city; the largest single unit. Anita: modern, not rooted.
candidates.source_note: 舞钢市 article in sources.md

candidates.name: Fangcheng
candidates.meaning: "Square wall": named for the Chu state's square-walled frontier, one of China's oldest great walls.
candidates.fit: 22% of the people but only 28% of the county; the county seat is outside. Anita: county seat is outside the region.
candidates.source_note: 方城县 article in sources.md

regions.notes: Wugang and Fangcheng rejected by Anita. Funiu and Tongbai avoided.

regions.summary: Zhumadian city: Yicheng district and the Suiping county seat.

candidates.name: Zhumadian
candidates.meaning: "Horses halt at the inn": a post station where couriers rested their horses.
candidates.fit: Holds the old centre (Yicheng, 74%) of a 7.0M city; central region takes the city name.
candidates.source_note: 驻马店是因为“旧为遂平至明港间驿马驻所”

regions.notes: Suiping (25%) is the only other unit.

regions.summary: Pingyu county plus Xiangcheng and Linquan edges on the Anhui border.

candidates.name: Pingyu
candidates.meaning: Old county of Pingyu, seat of Runan commandery in the Eastern Han.
candidates.fit: 61% of the people, 90% of the county, including the county seat.
candidates.source_note: 平舆县 (206 BC-1293) in CHGIS list; own article

candidates.name: Xiangcheng
candidates.meaning: County-level city named for the ancient state of Xiang.
candidates.fit: 26% of the people but only 29% of the city.
candidates.source_note: 项城县 seat listed in sources.md

regions.summary: Runan county and part of Zhengyang: the old prefecture seat of Runing.

candidates.name: Runan
candidates.meaning: "South of the Ru": Han commandery, long the capital of the Ru-Huai region (also the Butterfly Lovers' Liang-Zhu setting).
candidates.fit: 62% of the people, 98% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 汝南县 article in sources.md

candidates.name: Caizhou
candidates.meaning: "Cai prefecture": Sui-to-Song prefecture, named for the old state of Cai; the Mongol-Song siege of 1234 ended the Jin dynasty here.
candidates.fit: Seated at today's Runan for 530 years; also covered Shangcai, Xiping, Suiping and Zhengyang, so it spans most of this part of the map.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 182 hits with 河南, mainly about this place (Runan).
candidates.source_note: 蔡州 (606-1292) 今河南省汝南县

regions.notes: Caizhou covers neighbours too; Runan is the clean fit.

regions.summary: Xincai county and a slice of Linquan across the Anhui line.

candidates.name: Xincai
candidates.meaning: "New Cai": the later capital of Cai after it moved from Shangcai in 491 BC.
candidates.fit: 75% of the people, 88% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 蔡平侯复蔡国，并迁都吕亭（今新蔡县）

regions.notes: Linquan (19%) is in Anhui, probably claimed by the Fuyang agent.

regions.summary: Tongbai mountains and the Biyang basin: Biyang, Tongbai, Sheqi and Tanghe edges. Source of the Huai.

candidates.name: Tongbai
candidates.meaning: Tongbai range and county: the mountains where the Huai River rises.
candidates.fit: Region holds 94% of Tongbai county (34% of the people) and the range's eastern end; a landscape name covering the whole region.
candidates.recognisability: Current county and mountain name; no check needed.
candidates.source_note: 桐柏县 article in sources.md; 桐柏县 (598-1911) at Gu Xian

candidates.name: Biyang
candidates.meaning: "North of the Bi river": the county seat lies on the north bank of the Bi (Miyang) river.
candidates.fit: 53% of the people, 83% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 县治在泌阳河之北，得名泌阳

regions.summary: Queshan, the Pingqiao rural area (Mingang) and Zhumadian's southern edge, on the Tongbai-Dabie divide.

candidates.name: Queshan
candidates.meaning: "Sure mountain": renamed in 1012 from Langshan to avoid the taboo on Zhao Xuanlang.
candidates.fit: 33% of the people, 98% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 北宋大中祥符五年（1012年）……改朗山县为确山县

regions.notes: Pingqiao (32%) and Yicheng (19%) are a third of the people each; Mingang is a known town but not a good region name.

regions.summary: Huai river lowland: Huaibin, Funan across the river, and Gushi's western edge.

candidates.name: Huaibin
candidates.meaning: "Huai bank": the county seat lies on the bank of the Huai River.
candidates.fit: 50% of the people, 91% of the county, with its seat; the Huai runs through the region.
candidates.source_note: 淮滨县名因县城位于淮河之滨而得名

candidates.name: Qisi
candidates.meaning: Chu county; home of Sunshu Ao, the Chu prime minister who built the Qisi dam.
candidates.fit: Seat in Huaibin (725 years, Qin to Liang); the town survives as Qisi.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for the town; 45 hits with 河南, mostly Sunshu Ao and Gushi.
candidates.source_note: 期思县 (221 BC-504) 今河南淮滨东南期思

regions.notes: Funan (34%) is Anhui; the Fuyang agent may name it.

regions.summary: Xi county on the Huai plus northern Zhengyang.

candidates.name: Xi
candidates.meaning: Named for the ancient state of Xi (Xi Guo), the "first county under heaven"; Han Xinxi and Xizhou were its later names.
candidates.fit: 63% of the people, 99% of the county; the Huai runs through it. English form Xixian.
candidates.source_note: 远自西周周武王时期已经有息国的建制，堪称“天下第一县”

candidates.name: Zhengyang
candidates.meaning: "Straight sun": renamed in 1723 from Zhenyang to avoid a taboo.
candidates.fit: 29% of the people, 57% of the county.
candidates.source_note: 正阳县 (1723-1911) 今河南正阳县城

regions.notes: Xixian clashes with Xi county in Shanxi (Xi, 隰县) in English spelling.

regions.summary: Gushi county's north and east, plus Huoqiu across the line.

candidates.name: Gushi
candidates.meaning: "Firm beginning": county named in 556; Henan's most populous county.
candidates.fit: 74% of the people, 73% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 固始县 (556-1911) 今河南固始

regions.notes: Huoqiu (24%) is Anhui; the Lu'an agent may name it. Gushi also has 12% in region 16.

regions.summary: Huangchuan with half of Guangshan: the old Guangzhou prefecture core.

candidates.name: Huangchuan
candidates.meaning: "Huang river": named for the Huang river, site of the Han Yiyang county.
candidates.fit: 63% of the people, 98.5% of the county.
candidates.source_note: 潢川县 article in sources.md

candidates.name: Guangshan
candidates.meaning: "Light mountain": Sui-era county (598) that was also seat of Guangzhou prefecture for about 1,200 years.
candidates.fit: 32% of the people, 55% of the county; seat of Guangzhou prefecture.

regions.notes: Guangzhou, the prefecture name, collides with Guangzhou in Guangdong.

regions.summary: Xinyang city: Shihe district and the Pingqiao urban area.

candidates.name: Xinyang
candidates.meaning: Xinyang, "trust sun": name of the seat since the Song (976); known for Xinyang Maojian tea.
candidates.fit: Holds the old centre (Shihe, 70%) of a 6.2M city; central region takes the city name.

regions.summary: Luoshan, Xin county and southern Guangshan: Dabie mountain foothills.

candidates.name: Luoshan
candidates.meaning: "Luo mountain": named for Little Luo Mountain southwest of the county.
candidates.fit: 45% of the people, 98.5% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 因县境西南有小罗山，由此得名

candidates.name: Xinxian
candidates.meaning: "New county": a 20th-century county in the Dabie Mountains.
candidates.fit: 24% of the people, 99% of the county.
candidates.source_note: 新县 article in sources.md

regions.notes: Dabie Mountains (Dabieshan) could name this or 16, but it spans several other regions.

regions.summary: Dabie mountain core: Jinzhai (Anhui), Shangcheng, southern Gushi.

candidates.name: Shangcheng
candidates.meaning: "Shang city": county name from the Song dynasty (960); the ancient Yincheng seat lay here.
candidates.fit: 42% of the people, 88% of the county, with its seat.
candidates.source_note: 商城县 (960-1911) 今河南商城

candidates.name: Jinzhai
candidates.meaning: "Gold stockade": named for Jinjiazhai, now under Meishan reservoir; revolutionary base.
candidates.fit: 45% of the people, 94% of the county.
candidates.source_note: 金寨县得名于现已淹没于梅山水库之下的金家寨

regions.notes: Jinzhai is in Anhui; the Lu'an agent might also pick it. Dabie Mountains is another option.
